verdict.rationale: The Editor documents Checkpoints that snapshot a project and roll back when needed, plus Project Archive and Restore. Because scripts and Editor API/MCP-driven changes live inside the project, this gives coarse versioning and rollback of automated changes. There is no evidence of automation-specific versioning or review. Missing for 10: per-automation version history, a review/diff step for script or agent-made changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of checkpoint rollback.
